name: The journey that outlived the gong
summary: The gong belonged to a brief opening in the campaign, but the quest's final recognition was not identical to that moment. Treasure of the Timeless One remained a distinct conclusion for those who held the restored scepter after the opening war. Remembering that distinction keeps the journey larger than a race for a title. Across forests, libraries, mountains and seas, the work had gathered companions around a broken promise. Its completion remembered the long recovery, as well as the threshold that recovery had allowed the world to cross.
